format: kilix-game-kit KXPOLICY v1 (read by solitaire_tui/policy.py, pure Python)
origin: Self-trained from solitaire-tui's own engine. Labels come from the game's determinized rollout planner (solitaire_tui/planner.py). No third-party data or weights.
network: scores one candidate move at a time from features.move_features (FEATURE_VERSION 2, 32 floats of player-visible information plus the game's own position history); the player takes the best-scoring move of planner.candidate_moves

training.data: teacher games on seeds 10000-15999 (436,532 decisions with 2+ candidates)
training.loss: softmax cross-entropy over each decision's candidates (hard labels)
training.procedure: tools/neural/solnet.py collect, then train --loss hard --hidden 64,64; tools/neural/export_policy.py

selection.rule: highest win rate on seeds 800000-800499; ties go to the smaller network. Candidates: hard-label 64x64; soft-label (teacher values, tau 0.5) 32x32, 64x64 and 128x128; two DAgger rounds on the soft 128x128 (seeds 30000-39999)

held_out.ship_rule: beat greedy with non-overlapping Wilson intervals: met
held_out.caveat: below the filter-only baselines (a random or greedy choice among the same non-revisiting candidates), so the network's ranking of candidates is worse than chance there
